page.overview:
What is The Lady of the Lake?

The Lady of the Lake (Polish: Pani Jeziora) is the fifth novel in The Witcher series and the final in the original Witcher Saga, written by Polish fantasy writer Andrzej Sapkowski, first published in Poland in 1999. It is a sequel to the fourth Witcher novel, The Tower of the Swallow.
